trailer_bill_on_tax_credit_payouts.summary: A new trailer bill, Assembly Bill 186, aims to modify California's production tax incentive program amid concerns over the recent SB 122 cap.
highlights: SB 122 caps tax credits at $5 million or 70% of liability per year
AB 186 would accelerate refund payouts from five to two years and reduce the discount from 10% to 5%
The bill extends credit carry‑forward from 10 to 15 years and exempts independent productions from the cap

ab186_partial_carveout.headline: California Lawmakers Approve Partial Film Tax Credit Carveout

highlights: AB 186 creates a two‑year payback period with a reduced 5% discount for studios refunding credits
Independent film credits are fully exempt from the cap, covering 10% of the $750 million program
Non‑refundable credits issued before 2025 can be extended up to five years
The compromise balances studio and independent interests after negotiations with unions and the governor’s office
